name: agent-viz
description: A local, live picture of Claude Code and Codex sessions in an editor tab.

viewsWelcome.contents:
A live picture of your Claude Code and Codex sessions.
[Open Activity](command:agentviz.open)
[Settings](command:agentviz.settings)

agentviz.claudeRoot.description: Claude configuration folder. Empty uses the local .claude folder. Only its projects folder is read, plus the process and session IDs in its sessions folder, to tell which sessions are running.

enumDescriptions: Only sessions that are running now. A Claude session is running while its Claude Code process is; a Codex session while its transcript was written in the last 10 minutes.
agentviz.sessions.description: Whether AgentViz lists only running sessions. A session you are following stays followed after it ends.

enumDescriptions: Only sessions recorded in a folder of the workspace loaded in this window, or below one (worktrees included). They are one project, named after the workspace.
Every session in the configured Claude and Codex folders.
agentviz.scope.description: Which sessions AgentViz lists. With no folder open, every session is listed.

agentviz.codexRoot.description: Codex configuration folder. Empty uses the local .codex folder. Only its sessions folder is read.

scripts.check: node --check src/extension.js && node --check src/transcript.js && node --check src/sessions.js && node --check src/webview.js && node --check src/detail.js && node --check media/view.js && node --check media/app.js
